key_decisions.rationale: Retain the narrator's explanation and their shared age without turning childlessness into a moral judgment.

key_decisions.after: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was unable to conceive, and both were advanced in years.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserve the abstention and prenatal Spirit filling without assigning an unstated vow category.

key_decisions.after: for he will be great before the Lord. He must never drink wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother's womb.

key_decisions.rationale: Clarify the Lord as the preceding pronoun's referent; retain fathers, Elijah, and the two kinds of turning.
key_decisions.before: He will go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of parents toward their children and the disobedient toward the wisdom of the righteous, to prepare a people made ready for the Lord.”
key_decisions.after: He will go before the Lord in Elijah's spirit and power, turning fathers' hearts toward their children and the disobedient toward the wisdom of the righteous, to make a people ready for the Lord.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he will go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of parents to their children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous, to make ready for the Lord a people prepared.”

key_decisions.rationale: Resolve repeated pronouns and preserve their inference and his continued gestures without diagnosing deafness.

key_decisions.after: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized that he had seen a vision in the sanctuary. He kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they realized that he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them and remained unable to speak.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain Elizabeth's own interpretation and social disgrace as her speech rather than a judgment on infertility.
key_decisions.before: She said, “This is what the Lord has done for me in the days when he looked on me and took away my disgrace among people.”
key_decisions.after: “This is what the Lord has done for me. He has looked on me with favor and taken away my disgrace among people.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: “Thus the Lord has done for me in the days when the Lord looked on me, to take away my disgrace among people.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserve virgin, the binding marriage pledge, Joseph's Davidic connection, and Mary's introduction.
key_decisions.before: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph, from the house of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.
key_decisions.after: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph, of David's house. The virgin's name was Mary.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to a virgin engaged to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. And the virgin’s name was Mary.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain favor as something received and omit an additional blessing absent from the pinned text.

key_decisions.after: The angel came to her and said, “Greetings, favored one! The Lord is with you.”

key_decisions.rationale: Render the sexual knowing idiom naturally while preserving Mary's question about how, distinct from Zechariah's assurance question.
key_decisions.before: Mary said to the angel, “How will this be, since I have not had sexual relations with a man?”
key_decisions.after: Mary asked the angel, “How will this happen, since I have not been with a man?”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, since I have not known a man?”

key_decisions.rationale: Keep Spirit, power, overshadowing, and the explanatory therefore without supplying a physical mechanism.

key_decisions.after: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore the child to be born will be called holy, the Son of God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; therefore the holy child to be born will be called Son of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserve word and the promise's effective power; record the broader nothing-is-impossible alternative in a note.

key_decisions.rationale: Retain the female slave self-designation and Mary's voiced assent rather than erase either.
